Exquisite 5-Bedroom Villa in Palm Hills, Dubai Hills Estate | Golf Course Views

Step into a life of luxury with this stunning 5-bedroom villa in the highly sought-after Palm Hills enclave of Dubai Hills Estate. Set on a generous 7,104 sq. ft. plot, this beautifully designed home effortlessly combines modern elegance with timeless charm, offering sweeping views of the golf course and verdant landscapes.

Villa Features:
Spacious Balcony with Panoramic Views
Central Air Conditioning
Premium Marble Flooring
Covered Parking & Private Garage
Built-in Wardrobes
Maid’s Room + Study
Pet-Friendly Environment
Dedicated BBQ Area

Community Amenities:
Proximity to Mosques & Children’s Nursery
Ample Public Parking
24/7 Security for Peace of Mind

Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline, Dubai Hills Estate offers a fully integrated lifestyle surrounded by landscaped greens, world-class amenities, and pristine fairways. This exceptional villa is ideal for those seeking privacy, luxury, and convenience in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.
